module.purpose: Defines the Cloudflare Worker entrypoint for serving and uploading user assets through routed HTTP endpoints with CORS and origin protection.
module.summary: This module constructs a request router for user asset retrieval and upload operations, applies preflight and unknown-origin protections, and returns not-found responses for unmatched routes. The worker delegates request processing to shared handlers, supplies Cloudflare environment bindings and execution context, and applies CORS formatting to final API responses.
module.businessContext: Supports user asset storage for the dotcom application. Failures can prevent asset uploads, retrievals, or safe cross-origin access.
classes: Worker (~L17-50): Cloudflare entrypoint that routes authenticated asset requests and API responses
functions: fetch (~L41-49): Processes incoming requests through the configured router and CORS handler

io: Delegates incoming requests to shared API and asset handlers.
env: Reads the UPLOADS binding from the worker environment.

contractsProvided.name: Worker
contractsProvided.shape: export default class Worker extends WorkerEntrypoint<Environment>

contractsProvided.name: GET /uploads/:objectName
contractsProvided.shape: .get('/uploads/:objectName', async (request) => { return handleUserAssetGet({ request, bucket: this.env.UPLOADS, objectName: request.params.objectName, context: this.ctx }) })

contractsProvided.name: POST /uploads/:objectName
contractsProvided.shape: .post('/uploads/:objectName', async (request) => { return handleUserAssetUpload({ headers: request.headers, body: request.body, bucket: this.env.UPLOADS, objectName: request.params.objectName }) })

contractsConsumed.name: handleUserAssetGet
contractsConsumed.shape: handleUserAssetGet({ request, bucket: this.env.UPLOADS, objectName: request.params.objectName, context: this.ctx })

contractsConsumed.name: handleUserAssetUpload
contractsConsumed.shape: handleUserAssetUpload({ headers: request.headers, body: request.body, bucket: this.env.UPLOADS, objectName: request.params.objectName })

contractsConsumed.name: handleApiRequest
contractsConsumed.shape: handleApiRequest({ router: this.router, request, env: this.env, ctx: this.ctx, after: corsify })

edgeCases.behavior: The preflight middleware is invoked before other routing logic.
The origin-blocking middleware processes the request before asset routes.
Delegates retrieval using the route parameter and UPLOADS binding.
Delegates upload using headers, body, route parameter, and UPLOADS binding.

invariants.description: CORS preflight handling runs before unknown-origin blocking and route dispatch.
The not-found handler is registered after the asset routes as the final wildcard route.
Asset routes use the request object name parameter to select the storage object.

assumptions.description: The worker environment provides an UPLOADS binding compatible with the shared asset handlers.
Shared request handlers accept the request, route parameters, environment binding, and execution context in the supplied shapes.

ambiguities.question: What concrete response and failure behavior do the imported shared handlers provide for invalid uploads, missing objects, and storage errors?

concurrencyModel.notes: Each fetch invocation delegates independently using instance environment and execution context; asynchronous handler behavior is implemented by shared imports.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A GET request for an uploaded object is dispatched to the asset retrieval handler.
moduleContractTests.then: handleUserAssetGet receives request, env.UPLOADS, request.params.objectName equal to 'file.txt', and this.ctx
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the GET route, object-name extraction, bucket binding, and execution context propagation.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A POST request for an uploaded object is dispatched to the asset upload handler.
moduleContractTests.then: handleUserAssetUpload receives request.headers, request.body, env.UPLOADS, and request.params.objectName equal to 'file.txt'
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the POST route and forwarding of upload body, headers, bucket, and object name.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A request that matches neither upload route is handled by the not-found route.
moduleContractTests.then: notFound handles the request and the response is a not-found response
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the catch-all fallback after the upload routes.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A request from an origin rejected by the origin policy is blocked before reaching an upload handler.
given: const request = new Request('https://example.com/uploads/file.txt', { method: 'GET', headers: { Origin: 'https://disallowed.example' } })
moduleContractTests.then: blockUnknownOrigins prevents the request from reaching handleUserAssetGet
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins origin filtering as a router-wide prerequisite.
